outcome: Presence of mobile genetic elements (MGEs) and virulence genes
cohort: 62 preterm infants with and without necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) from three different hospitals
finding: The gut microbiota composition differed significantly between infants with and without NEC, and between hospitals, with higher levels of MGEs and virulence genes found on conjugative plasmids in NEC-positive infants and those from certain hospitals.
